retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s soul-inspired layout featuring a close-up portrait with a large afro hairstyle against a solid pastel background, paired with elegant swash-heavy serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, warm-toned studio portrait of a smiling woman with a prominent afro, set against a flat lavender-pink background with high-contrast, decorative serif text tucked into the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark hair creates a strong silhouette against the light pastel background
Typography is nested within the negative space created by the subject's head and the frame edge
Warm skin tones contrast with the cool lavender background and blue-toned clothing
The curve of the swash lettering echoes the rounded shape of the afro
coreInvariants: Large, rounded afro hairstyle as a primary silhouette element
Solid, desaturated lavender or pink background
High-contrast serif typography with decorative swashes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is slightly off-center to the right, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move up to the hair silhouette, then left to the decorative typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper left quadrant is utilized for text placement.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation background allows the high-contrast dark subject and text to pop.
paletteRestrictions: Deep indigo or black for text

letterConstructionRules: Extreme stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Elongated, curling swashes on capital letters and descenders
Tight letter spacing with occasional overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'B' and 'D' feature extended, looping swashes
Lowercase 'y' has a deep, decorative tail

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the open background space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying swash alternates for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the iconic 70s decorative serif look with heavy swashes.
Provides the necessary high contrast and elegant serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with a large, perfectly rounded afro, smiling warmly, wearing a light blue draped garment, against a solid flat lavender-pink background. Leave the upper left corner clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add title text in the upper left corner using a high-contrast serif font with decorative swashes in deep indigo. Stack the lines tightly with left alignment.

verificationChecks: Is the hair silhouette crisp against the background?
Do the swashes on the letters feel fluid and integrated?
Is the background a flat, desaturated pastel?
Is the text color high-contrast against the lavender?

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital sharpness; maintain a soft, film-like grain
Ensure typography does not use default system fonts
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait with Afro + Pastel Background + Swash Serif Typography = 70s Soul Aesthetic
